name: Connecticut Department of Revenue Services (DRS) - individual income tax
notes: Researched from public portal.ct.gov/drs pages only. myconneCT: Create a Username (federal AGI from a CT return in the last three years, or CT driver license/ID; Letter ID or recent payment/return amount or mailed PIN; email required); password at least 8 characters with upper, lower, number and special character, not the username; optional two-step verification (text, email, app) so mfa left at the family default. Pay without login: Make a Bill Payment with the Letter ID. ACH debit scheduled up to 45 days ahead (up to the due date per the tax information page), cancel pending ACH under More... > View Submissions > Pending; card payments via ACI Payments with a convenience fee (amount not published), no future dating, cannot be cancelled; no ACH credit for individual income tax. Letters under View Letters; secure messages under Send Message. Payment plans cannot be set up in myconneCT (maximum $50,000, 2-12 months); the pages read give no plan phone line, so the general Taxpayer Services number is used. No recurring AutoPay (inferred). Bank-payment fee not stated (bankCents 0 inferred).

sources.title: Tax Information - Resident Income Tax | DRS

passwordRule.message: Use at least 8 characters with upper and lower case letters, a number and a special character.

guest_pay.note: Make a Bill Payment without logging in, using the Letter ID in the top right corner of your notice.

autopay.note: myconneCT has no recurring automatic payments. You can schedule an ACH debit payment up to 45 days ahead.

scheduled_payment.note: ACH debit payments can be scheduled up to 45 days ahead and cancelled while pending. Card payments cannot be future-dated or cancelled.

payment_arrangement.note: Payment plans cannot be set up in myconneCT. Call DRS Taxpayer Services at 860-297-5962 or 800-382-9463 to discuss a plan; once a plan is in place, its payments appear in your Action Center.

notes: Card payments are processed by ACI Payments, Inc., which charges a convenience fee; the amount is shown before you confirm and DRS does not publish it.

help.title: Payment options
paragraphs: Pay in myconneCT by ACH debit from a checking or savings account, choosing a withdrawal date up to the due date, or by American Express, Discover, Mastercard, Visa or a comparable debit card.

The card service provider charges a convenience fee; you are told the amount and can cancel before paying. If you file a return with a balance due and pay by mail, send Form CT-1040V with your check or money order.

help.title: Schedule or cancel a payment
paragraphs: ACH debit payments can generally be scheduled up to 45 days in advance. Card payments cannot have a future payment date. A payment is on time if it is made by 11:59 p.m. Eastern on the due date.
Only pending ACH payments can be cancelled: open More..., choose View Submissions, open the Pending tab, select the payment and choose Cancel. Card payments cannot be cancelled once submitted.
To pay without logging in, choose Make a Bill Payment and enter the Letter ID from the top right corner of your notice. ACH credit is not available for individual income tax.

help.title: Payment plans
paragraphs: Payment plans cannot be set up in myconneCT. Plans are limited to balances of $50,000 or less and last from 2 to 12 months, depending on the minimum installment.
Call DRS Taxpayer Services at 860-297-5962 or 800-382-9463, Monday through Friday, 8:30 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. Once a plan is in place, a payment option for it appears in your myconneCT Action Center.

extra.intent: Using the CT DRS website's help pages, find how many days in advance an ACH debit payment can be scheduled in myconneCT. Do not make a payment or change any settings.

solution.text: ACH debit payments can be scheduled up to 45 days ahead.
